A '''Papal Outpost''' is the pack's replacement for the vanilla {{MCW|Pillager Outpost|pillager outpost}}: a ruined stone watchtower surrounded by graves and small camps, with no pillagers. It gives easy early-game access to a small amount of [[divine fragment]]s and [[crystal heart]]s, as well as potatoes and carrots.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Easy early-game access to a small amount of divine fragments and crystal hearts. They also provide potatoes and carrots}}</ref> Papal Outposts are much more common than [[Abbey]]s.

The structure keeps the vanilla ID <code>minecraft:pillager_outpost</code>, so it appears as a pillager outpost in commands such as <code>/locate</code>.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Papal outposts will register as Pillager Outposts (I got lazy, it was crunch time, leave me alone)}}</ref>

== Generation ==
Papal Outposts generate in the same biomes and with the same spacing as vanilla pillager outposts; the pack does not change the structure set or the biome tag. The structure no longer has a spawn override, so {{MCW|Pillager|pillagers}} do not spawn in it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/structure/pillager_outpost.json}}</ref> Pillager patrols are also delayed; see [[Day and night]].

A Papal Outpost Map can be bought from the [[Archaeologist]] at level 1 for one [[obol]]. See [[Explorer maps]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/1/papal_outpost.json}}</ref>

== Structure ==
The pack replaces the vanilla outpost templates while keeping the vanilla layout: a base plate, a watchtower, and a feature plate on which small features are placed.

=== Watchtower ===
The watchtower (15 × 21 × 15) is placed together with an overgrown copy of itself, which uses the <code>outpost_rot</code> processor: only 5% of its blocks are kept, and its magenta glazed terracotta becomes cobweb (30%) or air.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/template_pool/pillager_outpost/towers.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/processor_list/outpost_rot.json}}</ref> The tower contains:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/structure/pillager_outpost/watchtower.nbt}}</ref>
* A [[Zombie]] monster spawner (see [[Spawner]]).
* 3 trapped chests: two with [[Abbey]] barracks loot and one with Papal Outpost loot.
* 7 decorated pots with Abbey pot loot.
* 12 suspicious gravel blocks with grave loot.
* 6 brown beds, flower pots and spruce trapdoors.

=== Feature plate ===
The feature plate holds 17 suspicious gravel graves (grave loot) and connectors for features.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/structure/pillager_outpost/feature_plate.nbt}}</ref> Features are chosen from the pool below. All use the <code>cobwebs</code> processor, which turns magenta glazed terracotta into cobweb (30%) or air.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/template_pool/pillager_outpost/features.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The developer hopes to use the outposts "as a way to reverse-engineer how my structures could look in the future".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=I hope to use the Pillager outposts as a way to reverse-engineer how my structures could look in the future.}}</ref>
* The developer's notes list "Polish up papal outpost, give barrel a LT" as future work.<ref>{{Source|changelog.md}}</ref>
